intro.fr: Hearts of Iron IV a un randomizer sur le Steam Workshop depuis 2019.
intro.en: Hearts of Iron IV has had a randomizer on the Steam Workshop since 2019.

text.fr: Paradox Development Studio sort Hearts of Iron IV en 2016.
text.en: Paradox Development Studio releases Hearts of Iron IV in 2016.

text.fr: Le 18 mars 2019, Drowse publie sur le Steam Workshop un randomizer qui bouleverse la partie de base à chaque nouvelle partie ; il est mis à jour pour la version 1.7 du jeu.
text.en: On March 18, 2019, Drowse publishes a randomizer on the Steam Workshop that radically alters the vanilla game every playthrough; it is updated for the game's version 1.7.
